summary: Natuzzi S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of an involuntary delisting notice from the NYSE on August 26, 2026, due to failure to maintain the required $15 million average global market capitalization over 30 trading days. Trading in its ADSs (NTZ) was suspended; delisting proceedings commenced with no cure period. The company is reviewing options, including appeal. If delisting proceeds, it may trade OTC and evaluate filing Form 15 to deregister. This is an involuntary delisting event; no deal terms or advisor involvement. Watch for appeal decisions, OTC market liquidity, and potential deregistration filing.
